product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Desk Clamp Holder for Surge Protectors Power Strips USB Hubs
product.description: This desk clamp holder provides an easy way to organize your desk and keep power and data hubs and connections accessible. It clamps on to any desk edge and provides a way to attach surge protectors, power strips, and USB hubs for easy access. No more need for screws, zip ties, hook and loop fasteners, or double sided tape to mount power and data hubs. No more crawling under desks and reaching behind dusty PCs.Features: Easy, non-destructive way to attach power strips and USB hubs on your deskKeeps devices within easy reachDesigned for use with sit-stand desksSupport Files: Dimensions Diagram (Aug 14, 2018)
